note: Two reusable rule candidates emerged from the review findings; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: When an input accepts either a URL or a raw token/id, parse the URL and extract the relevant value before submitting it to the API.
candidates.rationale: The login form invited users to paste an access link or token, but initially sent the raw URL to the exchange endpoint. Adding a small parser made the UI promise match the backend contract.

candidates.text: Form inputs should expose a clear invalid/error API (e.g., separate error text and invalid boolean props) instead of requiring placeholder content to trigger visual error states.
candidates.rationale: The login page used a single-space error string just to turn the input border red. Adding an explicit `invalid` prop to `Input` made the intent clear and avoided emitting empty error-message elements.
